description: Implementation of NetworkManager plugin handling network interfaces, connectivity, WiFi scanning, signal quality, and external network testing commands.

classes.name: NetworkManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements network management functionalities including interface status, connectivity, WiFi scanning, signal quality, and external network tests.

methods.name: NetworkManagerImplementation
methods.description: Constructor initializing network endpoints, starting process monitor thread, and setting process info.

methods.name: Destructor
methods.description: Cleans up threads, stops monitoring, and releases resources.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Loads configuration parameters including STUN server, connectivity endpoints, and logging level.

methods.name: GetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves current STUN server endpoint and related parameters.

methods.name: SetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Updates STUN server endpoint and parameters.

methods.name: GetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves configured connectivity test endpoints.

methods.name: SetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Sets connectivity test endpoints.

methods.name: IsConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks internet connectivity status and returns IP version and interface.

methods.name: GetCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Retrieves URI for captive portal detection.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Returns the active primary network interface.

methods.name: GetPublicIP
methods.description: Obtains public IP address via STUN server for specified interface and IP version.

methods.name: SetLogLevel
methods.description: Sets network manager plugin log level.

methods.name: GetLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves current log level.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs ICMP ping to specified endpoint and returns results.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Performs traceroute to specified endpoint and returns results.

methods.name: executeExternally
methods.description: Executes network test commands and parses output into JSON responses.

methods.name: filterScanResults
methods.description: Filters WiFi scan results based on SSID list and frequency.

methods.name: ReportAvailableSSIDs
methods.description: Posts WiFi scan results after filtering.

methods.name: startWiFiSignalQualityMonitor
methods.description: Starts WiFi signal quality monitoring thread.

methods.name: stopWiFiSignalQualityMonitor
methods.description: Stops WiFi signal quality monitoring thread.

methods.name: GetWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Retrieves current WiFi signal quality metrics including SSID, strength, noise, SNR, and quality level.

methods.name: processMonitor
methods.description: Monitors process memory usage periodically.

methods.name: monitorThreadFunction
methods.description: Thread function to monitor WiFi signal quality at intervals.

methods.name: ReportWiFiStateChange
methods.description: Posts WiFi state change notifications.

methods.name: ReportWiFiSignalQualityChange
methods.description: Posts WiFi signal quality change notifications.
